tlog.msg: Deploying to a new island — new map sheets are in the library [P].

CHAPTER 3.2 — CLOSE ENOUGH TO SMELL IT (NORMAL). Friendly infantry advancing from grid 245 572 onto an enemy-held objective, grid bearing ~0000 mils. This WILL be danger close: your call must include the proword DANGER CLOSE, and a short round lands on our own people.
Par time for full stars: 7:00.
MET: wind from 5000 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 244 553, ground elev 265 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "SAWMILL" grid 266 551 (grid brg 1700) · AB1002 "CHAPEL" grid 232 561 (grid brg 5371). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages KELUFA and PARA — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
